title: Heritage Proposition Set
description:
HDTO's HC16 Heritage Proposition Set (⊑ crminf:I4 Proposition Set + HC15 Persistent Digital
Object): the named-graph content unit a `heritage-digital-twin` (HC2) actually "contains" via
HP33/HP34. Per D7.1's own worked example (Figures 16-17), a real HC16 instance is a
provenance-linked graph (digitization/study process → software/device → data output), not a
flat metadata bag — modelling that full CRMdig process chain is deliberately deferred (see
`description.md`); this schema covers the flat "what does this set assert, and about what" shape
needed to make HC2 usable now, with `content` as the extension point for deeper chains later.

id.description: Persistent URI identifying this proposition set (named graph).

label.description: Short human-readable label for this proposition set, e.g. naming the digitization/study batch it captures.

content.description: URIs of the register entities this proposition set's assertions are about or derived from (e.g. `digital-representation`/`three-d-model`/`survey-dataset`/`observation` instances it aggregates as evidence for the documented `heritage-object`). Modelled as a flat reference list (crm:P148_has_component) — the deeper process/software/device provenance chain D7.1's worked example shows (D2 Digitization Process, D14 Software, D6 Digital Device, D9 Data Object) is not modelled here; see `description.md`.

composedBy.description: URI of the `event` instance (co-typed hdto:HC11_Digital_Twin_Maintenance) that added this proposition set (HP30 added content, inverse direction — HP30i). Required: every proposition set exists because some maintenance activity produced it.

replaces.description: URI of the `heritage-proposition-set` this one supersedes within the same digital twin's version chain (HP32 replaced).
